title: get_reference_call_by_form_token query has zero test coverage
detail: New DB operation shipped without integration coverage. A round-trip test (set form_token via SQL, read back) would pin the WHERE-clause semantics and the COALESCE-column row mapping that squirrel codegen cannot fully guarantee at runtime.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test: insert a call, UPDATE form_token via raw pog.query, assert get_reference_call_by_form_token returns the row (and returns zero rows for an unknown token).

title: list_reference_calls_for_application query has zero test coverage
evidence:
FROM reference_call
WHERE application_id = $1
ORDER BY created_at, id;
(grep of server/test/ for `list_reference_calls_for_application` returns no matches — no test calls this new query)
detail: New DB operation with an ORDER BY contract shipped untested. Nothing pins the filter or the (created_at, id) ordering, which later sweep/panel stories will rely on.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test inserting two calls for one application (plus one for another), assert list returns both in created_at order and excludes the foreign application.

title: append_reference_call_attempt guard tested happy-path only
evidence:
rc_sql.append_reference_call_attempt(
      db,
      call_uuid,
      attempt,
      "2026-08-01 10:00:00+00",
      rc_sql.Queued,
    )
-- and the SQL guard it never violates:
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $4::reference_call_status
detail: The test named 'append_attempt_is_atomic_and_guarded' only appends with the matching expected status. The AD-14 guard's negative path (wrong expected status → zero rows, attempts unchanged) is untested, unlike the sibling update guard which has a negative test.
recommended_fix: Extend the test: call append_reference_call_attempt with a non-matching expected status, assert returned.rows == [] and attempt_count/attempts are unchanged.

title: reference_* notification types pinned only as migration text, never exercised against the DB
evidence:
"'reference_completed'", "'reference_unreachable'", "'reference_objected'",
      "'reference_declined'",
(grep of server/test/ shows these strings appear only in this file-grep test; nothing inserts a notification or calls the generated ReferenceCompleted/… encoder arms)
detail: The file-grep proves the ALTER TYPE statements exist, not that the enum accepts the values or that the squirrel-generated encoder arms map to the right strings; a typo there surfaces only in a later story.
recommended_fix: Add one integration assertion inserting/selecting a notification with a reference_* type (or a psql enum-range check) so the value-to-string mapping is pinned against the live DB.

title: Decode-error paths untested for RefSlot/OwnerLabel/Channel/ObjectionChannel decoders
detail: Only the status and outcome decoders have unknown-value rejection tests. The four TEXT+CHECK-mirrored decoders (ref_slot, owner_label, channel, objection_channel) and their from_string fallbacks have round-trips but no negative-path pin.
recommended_fix: Add four small tests asserting each of ref_slot_decoder/owner_label_decoder/channel_decoder/objection_channel_decoder errors on an unknown string (and optionally pin the documented fallbacks).

title: updated_at trigger bump asserted only as DDL text, never observed at DB level
evidence:
|> string.contains("EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()")
(grep of server/test/integration/reference_checks_integration_test.gleam for `updated_at` returns no matches — no test asserts the value changes on UPDATE)
detail: The file-grep pins the trigger DDL, but no integration test performs a guarded update and asserts updated_at advanced, so a dropped/no-op trigger would go unnoticed.
recommended_fix: In an existing guarded-transition test, capture updated_at before and after the update and assert it changed (or is non-empty and differs).

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 (Verify contract: migration-from-reset via integration setup + 11 schema pins, squirrel codegen compiled and called by tests, all-variant codec round-trips) = 100%. P1 (AC DB behaviors: slot uniqueness, skipped, terminal-frees, orphan, NULL discipline, guarded ±) = 100%. Residual P2/P3 gaps: two untested read queries, append guard negative, notification encoder arms, decoder rejects. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Add the three flagged integration tests (form_token lookup, list ordering, append guard negative) to lift P2 coverage to match P1.
